tokens.name: page-bg
tokens.usage: Page ground, as rendered behind the page's content. Every text pairing below is checked against it.

tokens.name: page-text
tokens.usage: Default body text on `page-bg`: the colour most of the page's text uses that reads on it (14.6:1).

tokens.name: clinical-blue
tokens.usage: Used as text on `.welcome-banner h2`, `.section-title`, `.timeline-date .date`. 8.0:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: medical-green
tokens.usage: Used as border on `.stat-card.green`, `.event-card.conference`; text on `.stat-card.green .stat-icon`, `.event-tag.cme`, `.compliance-notice li::before`. 3.0:1 on `page-bg` — large text (24px+) or non-text marks only.

tokens.name: success-green
tokens.usage: Success state; pair with a label or icon.

tokens.name: warning-amber
tokens.usage: Used as border on `.stat-card.amber`, `.event-card.webinar`; text on `.stat-card.amber .stat-icon`. 1.5:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Used as text on `.header`, `.nav-menu a`, `.badge-count`. 1.1:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: medium-gray
tokens.usage: Used as text on `.welcome-banner p`, `.stat-label`, `.cme-category h4`. 4.4:1 on `page-bg` — large text (24px+) or non-text marks only.

tokens.name: verified-badge
tokens.usage: Used as text on `.verification-status.verified`. 3.0:1 on `page-bg` — large text (24px+) or non-text marks only.

tokens.name: pending-status
tokens.usage: Used as border on `.credential-card.pending`; text on `.verification-status.pending`. 1.5:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: expired-status
tokens.usage: Used as border on `.credential-card.expired`; text on `.verification-status.expired`. 4.3:1 on `page-bg` — large text (24px+) or non-text marks only.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Hero and page titles — as `h1` on the reference page.

styles.name: heading-2
styles.usage: Section headings — as `h2` on the reference page.

styles.name: heading-3
styles.usage: Card and module titles — as `h3` on the reference page.

styles.name: heading-4
styles.usage: Minor headings, set in uppercase — as `h4` on the reference page.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Body copy — as `p` on the reference page.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Labels, eyebrows and table headers — as `div.stat-label` on the reference page.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Button labels — as `button.btn` on the reference page. The reference page leaves this element on the browser default face; set it in the body family.

tokens.name: space-xs
tokens.usage: Used as spacing on `.logo-text h1`, `.cme-category .credits`, `.credential-info h4`.

tokens.name: space-sm
tokens.usage: Used as spacing on `.welcome-banner h2`, `.stat-value`, `.cme-category h4`.
